heading: Before & after
lead: Read this before your session. Come back to it for two weeks after.

items.v: Valid government-issued photo ID. No ID, no ink.
Eat a proper meal within two hours of arrival. Low blood sugar makes long sessions miserable.
Drink water through the day. Avoid alcohol for 24 hours before — it thins your blood.
Loose, dark clothing that gives easy access to the area being tattooed.
Headphones, a downloaded show, a book. Long sessions need a way to vanish into your head.
Bring something small. Tomasz will tell you when to take a break.
Show up rested. Sessions on no sleep are sessions you'll regret.

after.title: Aftercare

phases.label: Day 0 — the first night
phases.body: Leave the wrap on for the time Tomasz tells you (usually 2–4 hours, or overnight if it's a Saniderm-style film). Gently wash with lukewarm water and a fragrance-free soap. Pat dry with a clean paper towel. Do not rub.

phases.label: Days 1–3
phases.body: Wash twice a day. Apply a thin layer of an unscented healing balm. The tattoo will weep plasma and ink — this is normal. Sleep on clean sheets. Wear loose clothing over the area.

phases.label: Days 4–14
phases.body: It will scab and flake. Do not pick, scratch, or peel. Keep moisturising with an unscented lotion. Itch is normal — slap, don't scratch. No pools, no baths, no saunas, no sea.

phases.label: Weeks 2–6
phases.body: The surface heals first, the deeper skin takes longer. Stay out of direct sun. Once fully healed, use SPF 50 on the tattoo any time it sees sunlight — this is the single biggest thing you can do to keep it sharp for decades.

donts: No pools, baths, sea, or saunas for at least two weeks.
No scented lotions, no petroleum jelly on a fresh tattoo.
No gym sessions that stretch or sweat-soak the area for the first week.
